narr: Training storms developed over the east slopes of the Sacramento Mountains as modest moisture remained in place with a disturbance moving through north-northeast flow aloft. Antecedent moisture and additional heavy rain over the area northeast of Mescalero lead to flash flooding and road closures.
ev: Flash flooding lead to closures along Highway 70 near mile marker 250 as well as NM-244 northeast of Mescalero. Torrential rainfall for an hour occurred with near zero visibility.
lsr: MESCALERO TRIBE EM REPORTS FLASH FLOODING IS ONGOING ALONG MUCH OF US-70 NEAR MILE MARKER 250 AND NM-244 NORTHEAST OF MESCALERO. TORRENTIAL RAINFALL OCCURRED OVER THE PAST HOUR WITH ZERO VISIBILITY.
